tickets.TITLE: 按UI实施地图补逐页responsive/state(遵循LUMENIS Design System)
tickets.ROOT_CAUSE: 本轮只锁定规模(6 templates/97 static/100 ui/180引用)与已证断点,不重设计
tickets.IMPLEMENTATION_INTENT: 按per-page字段逐页补responsive/loading/empty/error/permission态;旧UI仅作证据不复制
tickets.DB_GUARD: 所有DB操作走ZBC_DB_PATH临时库;受保护库连接护栏保持开启;前后sha256一致
tickets.SECURITY_CHECK: 不读取/打印密钥;写操作过permission_gate
tickets.ROLLBACK: 单purpose commit,失败git revert该commit;DB仅隔离副本可丢弃
tickets.DO_NOT_TOUCH: data/monitor.db及任何真实候选库(只在隔离副本);失败测试只改不改删;README/AGENTS/Governance;canonical main(禁直接push/force)
tickets.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED_FOR_CLOSE: 命令输出+测试结果+junit/探测JSON+受保护库hash不变证明
